newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCALA APPOINTED AS NEW DORTMUND COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCALA APPOINTED AS NEW DORTMUND COACH.

text.p: European Cup holders Borussia Dortmund said on Sunday they had signed Nevio Scala as their new coach after his current club Perugia agreed to release him from his contract.

Dortmund turned to the Italian, who guided Parma from the Italian second division to the European elite, after Ottmar Hitzfeld decided earlier this month to quit as coach and take over a new position as sports director at the club.

"We have appointed our number one choice. He has international experience and is the kind of trainer our club needs," said Dortmund president Gerd Niebaum at a news conference to present the new coach.
The 49-year-old Italian, who has signed a two-year contract, coached Parma to the 1993 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 1995 UEFA Cup.
He said on Sunday: "I know how difficult my task will be after the Champions League victory. Ottmar Hitzfeld's success is a tough act to follow."
The opera-loving coach -- who has a German wife and speaks fluent German -- is the second Italian coach in the Bundesliga, joining Giovanni Trapattoni at champions Bayern Munich.
Both Scala and Niebaum declined to comment on further new appointments within the team.
"We want to streamline the squad and plan to strengthen it, but not this summer," Niebaum said.
